template-injection.notes: Placeholders in run:, github-script and the code inputs of some well-known actions: attacker controlled contexts and objects holding them (template-injection), env variables set from them, and every other non-constant expansion (template-injection-expansion).

hardcoded-container-credentials.notes: The credentials rule reports a literal password in container or services credentials.

excessive-permissions.notes: Only the opt-in require-permissions check (no permissions block at all). Broad write scopes are not reported yet.

unpinned-uses.notes: Only the opt-in require-commit-hash check, for actions and for reusable workflows.

jactionlint.message_contains: must be pinned to a full-length commit SHA
must be pinned to a full-length commit SHA

unpinned-images.notes: Only docker:// action references under require-commit-hash. container: and services: images are not checked yet.

jactionlint.message_contains: docker image must be pinned to a digest

unsound-ternary.notes: jactionlint reports the falsy ternary idiom. zizmor 1.30.1 has no audit of this name, so this entry stays inert until a matching audit exists.

forbidden-uses.notes: required-actions enforces a required set of actions. zizmor's allow and deny lists are the inverse and are not covered yet.

bot-conditions.notes: github.actor and the other last-actor properties compared with bot accounts in job and step if: conditions, on events where the actor is not the author. No fixes for contexts other than a pull request.

obfuscation.notes: Redundant path segments at uses:, fromJSON(toJSON(x)) and format() with literal arguments.

unsound-condition.notes: if-always-true reports every condition with characters around ${{ }}, which includes the trailing newline of a block scalar.
